external_entities.name: other teams' backend
external_entities.description: Backend services operated by other teams that call the inference gateway.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
external_entities.notes: The text refers to multiple calling services, represented as one generic external-system entity.

external_entities.name: ML engineer
external_entities.description: Engineers who publish new model artifacts to the model registry bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.notes: The source is unsure whether publishing is governed by a shared group account: "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account."

processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service on GKE that receives inference requests from calling backends and forwards them to the model server.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE
processes.notes: Callers pass API keys to this service in a header.

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The service that runs the actual model on GPU nodes and reads model artifacts and customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network
processes.notes: The source says artifact integrity is not believed to be verified: "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket from which the model server loads model artifacts at startup and to which ML engineers publish new artifacts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup.
data_stores.notes: Artifact integrity verification is not stated; the source says, "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features such as account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The features include account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.notes: Redis has no password and is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts that users may have typed.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging.
data_stores.notes: The source says the log includes raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.notes: Callers pass an API key in a header.

data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup.

data_flows.description: The model server reads customer features from the Redis feature store.

trust_boundaries.name: model network
trust_boundaries.description: The network containing the model server and Redis feature store; it is intended to be reachable only from the inference gateway.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the model network is meant to be reachable only from the gateway

assumptions.assumption: The inference gateway presents a web interface.
